body:
fixes #1537

Summary:

When the user passed values={on: -2, off: 5}, we would send to Algolia as for facet refinements: stock:-2 which would not be what we wanted to express.

Using stock:-2 as a facetRefinement is supported only if you escape
the minus sign, otherwise it's considered as negative facet refinement
(remove "-2" from facets).

Now we escape this sign when it makes sense.
title: fix(toggle): support negative numeric values for on/off
